scope: GT facts and reference resources; no QA or model inference
target_rows: flag == 1 and class == 1; retain GT ID 0
timestamp: (original 1-based frame_id - 1) / fps; retain original full-sequence time even in half-val

coordinates.unified: continuous xywh pixel edges, 0-based; no clipping or interpolation
coordinates.MOT17: subtract 1 from source x,y under documented MOT17 1-based coordinate convention
coordinates.DanceTrack: retain released x,y; raw source boxes are retained separately
coordinates.SportsMOT: retain released x,y; raw source boxes are retained separately

gap.duration: number of absent/not-visible frames divided by fps
gap.edge_test: signed bbox-to-edge distance / respective width or height < threshold
gap.internal_gap_evidence: both last visible and next visible frames; terminal absences reported separately
gap.terminal: only when remaining invisible frames / fps > 1; right-censored at video end
gap.event_label_meaning: operational GT-derived edge heuristic specified by the task, not independent semantic occlusion annotations

entry: first visible occurrence touches edge; frame-1 entries are left-censored and not used as event references

overlap.crossing: opposite nonzero signs of x_a-x_b immediately before and after an overlap episode; both people must be visible at both evidence frames
overlap.unknown_crossing: missing/censored evidence or tied centers; never convert unknown into a negative

screen_distance: sum of center displacement over consecutive visible frames only / image diagonal; gaps not bridged; camera-motion tag retained

appearance.duplicate_policy: union original per-frame target IDs across all matching description files; retain every provenance path
appearance.unique: exactly one labeled GT target also visible at t_ref
appearance.warning: annotation uniqueness alone does not verify visual truth or provide independent QA count

event_reference.comparison: inclusive +/-1 second over all actors of the same event type
event_reference.disappearance_t_ref: last visible frame; text time is first invisible frame
event_reference.eligibility: all evidence frames within provisional source window; exclude left-censored entries

source_scope: inventory all 162 public-GT sequences; eligible references only Dance val, Sports val, MOT17 train second half

identity_limits.MOT17: same GT ID does not cover real-person exit/re-entry; do not use unseen-ID absence as a natural-person never-returns label
identity_limits.DanceTrack: same ID guaranteed after full occlusion; general out-of-view re-entry identity guarantee unconfirmed
identity_limits.SportsMOT: publisher specifies one athlete ID throughout the clip

display_precision_revision.reason: observed 82 wrong position targets, 2 out-of-range timestamps, 2 event-uniqueness changes after 0.1s rounding
